description: This file defines extension methods for configuring Orleans silo and client builders to use ZooKeeper for clustering, including setting options and registering related services.

classes.name: ZooKeeperHostingExtensions
classes.description: Contains static extension methods for configuring ZooKeeper clustering in Orleans.

methods.name: UseZooKeeperClustering (ISiloBuilder, Action<ZooKeeperClusteringSiloOptions>)
methods.description: Configures an Orleans silo to use ZooKeeper for cluster membership with custom options.

methods.name: UseZooKeeperClustering (ISiloBuilder, Action<OptionsBuilder<ZooKeeperClusteringSiloOptions>>)
methods.description: Sets up ZooKeeper clustering in an Orleans silo with options configured through OptionsBuilder.

methods.name: UseZooKeeperClustering (IClientBuilder, Action<ZooKeeperGatewayListProviderOptions>)
methods.description: Configures an Orleans client to use ZooKeeper for clustering with custom options.

methods.name: UseZooKeeperClustering (IClientBuilder, Action<OptionsBuilder<ZooKeeperGatewayListProviderOptions>>)
methods.description: Sets up ZooKeeper as the gateway list provider for an Orleans client with specified options.
